summary.one_liner: A curated awesome-style list of links covering software billing, pricing, invoicing, accounting, payments, and fraud resources for developers.
summary.what_it_does: This is an annotated link list rather than a software project. It is organized by topic: Basics, Pricing (usage-based, subscription, hybrid, strategy, market research), Product Catalog, Calculator, Cost Forecast, Marketplace (cloud resources, online ads), Accounting (double-entry, bookkeeping, software design, currencies), Finance, Contracts, Coupons, Taxes (including European VAT), Invoice (structure, integrity, generators, extractors, e-invoices), Payments, Fraud, UX/UI, Business Intelligence, and Competitive Analysis. Entries are mostly articles, papers, and talks, with some open-source libraries and tools marked with a free or paid-tier note. The README is truncated, so the later sections (Trust Score, Business Intelligence, Competitive Analysis, History, Humour) were not reviewed.
use_cases: Learning how to design a billing or invoicing system
Finding open-source double-entry ledger or accounting libraries
Researching usage-based and subscription pricing models
Reviewing European VAT and e-invoicing references
Looking up cloud spot-instance and cloud pricing research
notable: Organized by billing lifecycle, from pricing and product catalog through invoicing, payments, and fraud
Marks open-source tools with a free or paid-tier note, such as Lago, Formance Ledger, and TigerBeetle
Includes a dedicated European VAT and electronic invoicing section
Covers double-entry accounting concepts with implementation resources for developers
caveats: Mostly links to external articles and papers, so content depends on those sites staying online
README is truncated; some sections were not visible
Some listed projects are archived or dormant, such as RTB4Free and Mojaloop Fraud Risk Management
